name: Al-Muhalhil
bio: Adi ibn Rabi‘a belonged to the Jusham branch of Taghlib in Najd. His brother Kulayb nicknamed him Zir al-Nisa for the time he spent in women’s company. When Jassas ibn Murra killed Kulayb, al-Muhalhil became a leading figure on Taghlib’s side in accounts of the Basus war with Bakr. Early transmitters preserved his laments for Kulayb, and his story later grew into the popular epic of al-Zir Salim. Al-Zirikli places his death around 100 years before the Hijra (525 CE).
